policy: One separately constructed alphabet per genuinely distinct family; anchor artists are reference, not copying targets; do not alter production graff unless tested/approved.

families.name: Interlocked marker constructions
families.letters: A K M R S X
families.rule: Crowded contours; acute crossings; wedge terminations; compressed counterforms

families.name: Linear and skeletal handstyles
families.letters: A G O Q R Y
families.rule: Open thin skeletons; bar-crossed circular counters; visibly exposed joins

families.name: Cut-wedge angular signatures
families.letters: B G K M R S
families.rule: Triangular stroke ends; slanted folded segments; split angular counters

families.name: Block and rectilinear alphabets
families.letters: B D E G O P R
families.rule: Rectangular bowls and crossbars; stiff axes; deliberate spacing

families.name: Blackletter and fractured Gothic
families.letters: A B G M S Y
families.rule: High vertical stress; diamond ends; narrow bowls; repeated fracturing

families.name: Broad-nib calligraffiti
families.letters: A B K S U Y
families.rule: Consistent nib-angle contrast; ribbon entries; cut exits

families.name: Rotational loops and round scripts
families.letters: B G O Q S U
families.rule: Repeated oval rotations and crossed circular paths; swinging return strokes

families.name: Fragmented slash and broken brush
families.letters: A E K R S Z
families.rule: Interrupted slash fragments; broken joint forms; discontinuous diagonals

families.name: Sparse and airy gesture lettering
families.letters: A G L O Q Y
families.rule: Economical long stems; unclosed counters; large amounts of whitespace

families.name: Fast kinetic sweep handstyles
families.letters: A E K R S T
families.rule: Swung gestures; pointed directional reversals; long oblique entry/exit strokes
